name: the-event-store-monorepo
description: THE EVENT STORE — Inventory-backed e-commerce site for event props and decor with Admin POS and RBAC

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.dev: npx concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "magenta,cyan" "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
